source.title: Optional API supplier / Provider proposal with settled model costs
source.body:
Hi AI SaaS Starter team — I’m Yami from ToAPIs.

We reviewed your image-provider interface, authenticated generation flow and append-only credits ledger and prepared original API examples, model-specific parameters and dated Key rates:
https://github.com/ToAPIs-2025/lower-cost-ai-saas-starter-toapis

On October 29, our test Key settled gpt-image-2 / 1K at $0.015/image and gpt-image-2.5-flare / 1K at $0.0225/image. These are independent API results, not native product acceptance or universal tariffs.

We can support three practical routes: an optional Provider with evaluation credits and hands-on integration/debugging help; product/documentation sponsorship; or supplementary upstream API supply for your own hosted service. Larger-volume pricing can be discussed against your required models, specifications and expected usage. We would keep the existing Stripe/auth boundaries and retail credits ledger unchanged; the optional supplier would sit behind your provider interface.

Could the maintainer responsible for image/video models or upstream sourcing review these options? We would be happy to support a model your team actually needs and agree an evaluation scope together.

Thank you,
YamiAnn — ToAPIs Team
yami@toapis.com
